title: What's Cooking in Business Central: Cookies and Collectible Errors in the REST Client

chapters.title: Cookie Support in REST Client Module
Exception Handling Overview and Previous Behavior
Collectible Errors and Error Collection Pattern
REST Client Exception Enum and Try-Catch Pattern

features.name: Cookie Support in REST Client
features.description: The REST client module now supports cookies with functions to set cookies on requests, read cookies from responses, and work with cookie objects including properties like domain and secret.
features.status_evidence_quote: in the next version of the rest client module that will be released with version 26 of business Central the rest client module now
caveats: Requires creating a cookie object to set extra properties like domain or secret

features.name: Get Cookie Names Function
features.description: Function that returns a list of all cookie names available in the response message to check if a certain cookie was returned.
caveats: Returns an empty cookie if the cookie does not exist

features.name: Get Cookies Dictionary Function
features.description: Function that returns a full dictionary of all cookies with names as keys, providing a more convenient way to work with cookies compared to just getting a list of names.

features.name: Collectible Errors in REST Client
features.description: New error handling pattern that allows the REST client to throw collectible errors instead of normal errors when error collection is enabled, enabling graceful error handling for connection issues, invalid JSON, and HTTP errors.
caveats: Only one error will be collected because the REST client stops at the first failure
Requires adding error behavior line to the function

features.name: REST Client Exception Enum
features.description: Enum providing exception codes for different error conditions including blocked by environment, connection failed, request failed (HTTP errors), invalid JSON, invalid XML, and unknown errors.

features.name: REST Client Exception Builder
features.description: A builder function that conveniently retrieves the REST client exception enum from error information custom dimensions, allowing testing of specific exception codes.
